title: hypericum montanum var. scaberulum
intro: Hypericum montanum var. scaberulum, commonly known as a variety of St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant in the St. John's Wort genus. It has been traditionally used to support mental and physical well-being, with potential health benefits including the alleviation of mild to moderate depression, anxiety, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the neurotransmitter system, promote relaxation, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum montanum var. scaberulum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
